restaurantName: Le Saint-Nicolas - Au Coin du Feu
bio: In this pretty Savoyard chalet on the heights of Megève, with a kitchen opening onto a pleasantly rustic-chic dining area, all done out in wood, you can appreciate the attention paid to detail by chef Marvin Lance, previously Julien Gatillon's sous-chef at Le 1920. His set menus – dubbed Horizon, Relief and Origine – reflect his creative dishes, which boldly combine his Breton roots and the Savoyard terroir, eg scallops with Villazata white bacon and Haute-Savoie globe artichokes....
pageTitle: Le Saint-Nicolas - Au Coin du Feu
